# Ten Paragraph Sample

The library opens at eight in the morning. A few readers wait outside the door.

Rain fell all night, so the streets were still wet when the first bus arrived.

A small notice on the wall explains the new opening hours for the reading room.

The librarian sorts the returned books into two piles beside the window.

Visitors may borrow up to six books at a time. Reference books stay in the room.

这一段是中文原文，分析流程应该直接跳过，不应该再发请求给模型，也不应该被算成失败段落。

![Reading room notice](https://example.com/notice.png)

| Day | Hours |
| --- | --- |
| Monday | 08:00-18:00 |
| Sunday | Closed |

Members who need a quieter desk can book a seat on the second floor.

The reading room closes at six, and the last bus leaves ten minutes later.
